# Frozen companyfacts for the annual-pair pins

`tests/test_annual_pairs.py` reads these. They track NO page and are never regenerated by
`scripts/build_companyfacts_fixture.py`: each one freezes a real filer in a shape the pairing and
staleness rules must read correctly (STATE.md §5.0 row 11,
`docs/records/2026-10-27-combined-annual-figures-read-one-fiscal-year.md`).

Cut 2026-10-27 from the shared SEC cache, unmodified apart from the tag subset. Each keeps every
alias (`vinci.edgar.concepts.CONCEPT_ALIASES`) of the concepts its pins read, plus revenue's,
in the exact companyfacts shape, `sort_keys` and `indent=1` like the other frozen fixtures. JNJ
also keeps `vinci.edgar.net_debt.READ_TAGS`, so its net-leverage pin reads a real net debt.
INOD also keeps `StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOptionsExercised`, the tag whose 2034 context
is its frontier.

**Checked at cut time, against the full blob:** the subset's newest fiscal year
(`filer_fiscal_year`) ends on the same day, and every `current_annual` / `current_pair` the
pins read returns the same result. The subset names the fiscal year by the same tag, except
AMZN's: the full blob dates it by `NetIncomeLoss`'s trailing column, the subset by
`DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization`'s, both to 2026-06-30, and no AMZN pin reads the tag.

| file | filer (CIK) | fetched | concepts kept | newest fiscal year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `JNJ.json` | Johnson & Johnson (200406) | 2026-10-26 | operating income, D&A, operating cash flow, capex, revenue + net-debt lines | 2025-12-28 |
| `SLG.json` | SL Green Realty (1040971) | 2026-08-13 | operating income, D&A, operating cash flow, capex, revenue | 2025-12-31 |
| `AMZN.json` | Amazon.com (1018724) | 2026-10-26 | operating income, D&A, revenue | 2026-06-30 (a 10-Q's trailing column) |
| `TDAY.json` | USA TODAY Co. (1579684) | 2026-09-17 | operating income, D&A, revenue | 2025-12-31 |
| `VLO.json` | Valero Energy (1035002) | 2026-10-26 | operating cash flow, capex, revenue | 2025-12-31 |
| `FUBO.json` | FuboTV (1484769) | 2026-10-22 | operating cash flow, capex, revenue | 2024-12-31 |
| `DJCO.json` | Daily Journal (783412) | 2026-08-13 | diluted EPS, pre-tax income, revenue | 2025-09-30 (2012-09-30 as filed 2013-08-14) |
| `INOD.json` | Innodata (903651) | 2026-08-13 | operating income, revenue + one share-option tag | 2025-12-31 |
